extDescription.message: Puts tabs you haven't opened in a while to sleep to free memory. Never touches tabs with audio, typed text or sites you choose.

enabledTitle.message: Turn automatic tab sleeping on or off

pressureThresholdLabel.message: Memory is low when free is below

protectAudible.message: Don't sleep tabs playing audio (music, video, calls)

protectForms.message: Don't sleep tabs where you started typing (email, comment, form)

whitelistHint.message: One per line. Subdomains count too: example.com covers m.example.com.

howItWorks.message: A sleeping tab stays in place and uses almost no memory. Click it and it reloads.

resetConfirm.message: Restore default settings and site list?

memUnknown.message: This browser doesn't report free memory — using a timer only.

ruleNormal.message: Tabs you haven't opened for $1 min go to sleep.

rulePressure.message: Memory is low — tabs sleep after just $1 min.

sleptNone.message: Nothing to sleep — inactive tabs are already asleep or protected.
